judged.text: To the rider and the driver: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00103, weight 1.0, unbroken 175 fixes at 10 s) measures 11.18 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal of 8.2 km (EV-TRIP-00103) — an excess of 2.98 km, or 36.34%.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-00103 derived deviation.thresholds (POL-RD-01: 20% / 0.8 km establishment, 50% / 8.0 km materiality)
judged.text: Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so a route deviation is established on this trip's own trace; it is not a MATERIAL deviation (both figures sit under the 50% and 8.0 km thresholds).
The deviation is nevertheless fully exonerated under POL-RD-03.

The LTA DataMall advisory EV-ADVIS-00103-01 (weight 1.0) closes Braddell Road (towards Serangoon) between Lorong 1 Toa Payoh and Bishan Rd from 05:30 to 12:00, a road the booked optimal route itself uses, and its window overlaps the 08:07–08:36 trip.

The POL-RD-03 cap is min(2.98 km, 1.30 x (10.6 - 8.2) + 1.00 = 4.12 km) = 2.98 km, so the whole excess is justified and the distance-time charges stand; POL-RD-02 therefore does not run in either direction, and no distance refund is owed.

judged.evidence: EV-TRIP-00103 optimal_route_erp_sgd 0.0; EV-FARE-00103 erp_gantries / erp_lines (off 4.00, on 0.00)

Under POL-RD-09(2) those off-route charges are refunded to the rider as a standalone pass-through correction because the rider did not cause the closure either; the $4.00 is well under the $12.00 per-trip cap.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-00103 erp_gantry_proximity nearest_fix (0.0 m, 40.2497 m) vs POL-RD-09(4) 250 m radius
judged.text: Both gantries are genuine crossings — the nearest trace fixes are 0.0 m and 40.25 m away, inside the 250 m match radius — so POL-RD-09(4) yields no phantom-line finding and no billing-integrity referral.
The $4.00 is refunded once only: because POL-RD-03 fully excuses the deviation, POL-RD-02 does not also run, so there is no double count under POL-RD-09(1).

On the parties' arguments: the rider's claims that the deviation is established and that the $4.00 is off-route ERP are accepted; the driver's claims that the closure exonerates the distance and time lines, that the two gantries are real, and that the rider's only recovery is the capped pass-through are also accepted, and both advocates arrive at the same $4.00 figure under POL-RD-09(2).

judged.text: To both parties: the contested charge is SGD 33.77 (EV-FARE-00108, charged_total).

The trip was booked Blk 118 Rivervale Drive → Changi Terminal 1 on a 21.0 km optimal route, but the record shows the endpoints were amended twice, both at the rider's own request: the pickup was moved to Punggol MRT at 07:12:30 and the dropoff was changed from T1 to T3 at 07:41:52 (EV-TRIP-00108; EV-CHAT-00108, MSG-00108-001 and MSG-00108-003, each acknowledged by the driver).

Under POL-RD-05 the deviation test is re-run against the route between the amended endpoints — the stored amended_optimal_distance_km of 24.60 km with amended_optimal_duration_min of 31.0 — and not the superseded 21.0 km figure the rider's receipt quotes.
Measured on that baseline, the governing GPS distance (EV-GPS-00108, trace_distance_km 26.17 km, weight 1.0) exceeds the amended optimal by 1.57 km, which is 6.4% of it.
POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess exceeds BOTH 20% of the optimal distance AND 0.8 km absolute; the percentage gate fails, so no deviation is established.

POL-RD-05 directs NO_ACTION where no deviation survives the recomputation, and because no deviation is established POL-RD-02's fare recomputation does not run and no distance or time refund issues; the charge stands.
(1) The 'usually about 21 km' comparison measures against the pre-amendment route the vehicle did not drive, so it is a wrong-baseline comparison and is rejected on that ground.

(2) The derived deviation status 'established' at 5.17 km / 24.6% (EV-GPS-00108) was computed against the booked 21.0 km baseline and predates the POL-RD-05 re-baselining, so it does not displace the amended figure; the deciding arithmetic is the amended 24.60 km.

(4) The contention that the driver never invoked POL-RD-05 does not survive: the driver's brief cites POL-RD-05 together with EV-TRIP-00108, EV-GPS-00108 and EV-CHAT-00108, and in any event the clause re-baselines the analysis on the record itself.

The no-repeat-pattern finding is accepted: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 402 completed trips in 90 days, so POL-RD-06 supplies no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral, and prior_deviation_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

The GPS trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (206 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, empty gaps, max gap 0 s), so POL-RD-07's independent-corroboration requirement never attaches and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

There is no billing-integrity defect: no airport surcharge is charged (correct, because this trip ENDS at Changi rather than originating there), ERP and tolls are zero, and the fare lines reconcile to the cent against SGD 33.77, so POL-RD-09(4) yields no standalone refund and no referral.
No driver compensation arises either: the billed 26.2 km is not less than the trace distance, so POL-RD-04's unbilled-kilometre shortfall limb has nothing to bite on.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, trip_id TRP-00108 matches across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, the trace is unimpaired, the amendment re-quote is present and non-null, and no charge line lacks a counterpart.

judged.evidence: EV-TRIP-00202 (case DSP-00202; rider RDR-00951, driver DRV-00446, USD/SGD 6.00 no-show charge, trip TRP-00202)
judged.text: Decision on trip TRP-00202 and the disputed SGD 6.00 no-show fee, for Ms Rider (RDR-00951) and Mr Driver (DRV-00446).
Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold, and all four do.
(a) EV-TRIP-00202 records the driver's 'arrived' event at 2026-07-24T23:13:10.
(b) EV-GPS-00202 places the driver inside the AIRPORT arrival radius of 150 m on 63 qualifying fixes, the first at 23:12:45 — 25 seconds before the arrived event, as limb (b) requires.

(c) The driver then held position continuously for 620 seconds (23:12:45 to 23:23:05), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap, against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum — a surplus of 140 seconds.
(d) The driver terminated at 23:23:20 on reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the minimum had elapsed, with no boarding event (started_at and ended_at null).

judged.evidence: POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06; EV-GPS-00202.derived.arrival (no shortfall, no false marker, inside radius)
judged.text: Nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee.
POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply because the whole hold was inside the 150 m radius, closest approach 22.4 m.
POL-NS-05 (false marker) does not apply because at 23:13:10 the driver was already stationary inside the geofence; neither trigger (over 300 m, or 15 km/h or more) is present.

POL-NS-06 gives no shortfall refund: the derived shortfall is -140 seconds, a surplus, and EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the limb (i) accumulation rule is unavailable and unneeded.

judged.evidence: EV-CHAT-00202.admissibility (IMPAIRED, 0.85, UNREAD_MESSAGE); payload.messages read_at null; EV-TRIP-00202.in_app_calls []
judged.text: I accept your account as far as the record goes: the system notice (23:13:11) and both driver messages (23:14:02, 23:19:30) carry read_at null, no in-app call was made, and EV-CHAT-00202 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE.

judged.evidence: EV-CHAT-00202.payload.messages (3, none from rider); POL-NS-04 limb (a); POL-NS-01
judged.text: But the waiting-period rule is strict liability: no limb of POL-NS-01 asks where the rider was or whether she saw the messages, and the clause that could have exonerated you, POL-NS-04, requires as limb (a) that you sent a locating or coordinating message during the window — the log holds three messages and none is yours.
Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is undecidable, not satisfied or failed: 0 of 88 rider fixes pass the 25 m accuracy filter and, under POL-NS-04, that is neutral rather than adverse.
None of the POL-NS-09 triggers fires.
The deciding facts — arrival, dwell and the fee — are carried by EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 and EV-FARE-00202, each at weight 1.0, so no confidence cap below the 0.70 floor applies.
rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0.
rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 limb (d) reads.
The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-00202.derived.arrival (in-geofence run, no false marker); POL-NS-05(ii)
judged.text: POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival record is not triggered because the marker was genuine.
Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, that is SGD 4.80; the platform retains SGD 1.20.
The anti-farming guard fails on both limbs: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (needs 4 or more) and 1 / 168 completed trips = 0.006 (needs above 0.08), so compensation is paid.

The fare reconciles under POL-NS-08(d): the resolution rule takes the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so SGD 6.00 governs on the zone-class dimension and matches the charged line.
Per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 4.80.

The ruling rests on EV-GPS-00202, EV-TRIP-00202 and EV-FARE-00202 (each weight 1.0) for arrival, dwell and the fee, and on EV-DPROF-00202 (weight 0.9, SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH) for the anti-farming guard; the lowest weight among the carriers of the ruling's facts is 0.9, so confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor.

judged.text: Rider and driver: the disputed SGD 4.00 cancellation fee cannot stand on this record, and it is refunded in full to the rider.

The trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 12:41:50 (limb (a)), the GPS trace places the driver 94.94 m from the pin — inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius — from that same timestamp (limb (b)), he then held position for a continuous 340-second in-geofence dwell, 40 seconds over the 300-second minimum (limb (c)), and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:47:30 under RIDER_UNREACHABLE with no boarding event (limb (d)).
So POL-NS-01 is made out on its four limbs.
But POL-NS-01 charges the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does.
POL-NS-04 is satisfied on all three limbs.
(a) The 12:41:05 message, 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?', both states the rider's own position and entrance and asks for the driver's; the 12:44:40 message, 'boss?

(b) The chat log contains no driver message at any point — the middle entry is the platform's own 'Your driver has arrived' system notice, not a reply — and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor made an in-app call before terminating.

(c) The rider track's 105 fixes, all qualifying, sit within a maximum of 39.93 m of the pin (mean 21.08 m), well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius, for every fix rather than merely the majority.
On the driver's claims: POL-NS-01 is made out but displaced by POL-NS-04, so it does not carry the fee.
The SGD 3.20 compensation under POL-NS-07 does not arise, because compensation is payable only where POL-NS-01 stands and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it.

POL-NS-02 (geofence met), POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance band not reached — the driver never fell in the 120–400 m band), POL-NS-05 (marker genuine, driver stationary) and POL-NS-06 (no shortfall) are each correctly analysed, and each simply confirms the fee is decided by POL-NS-04 rather than by them.
The anti-farming guard under POL-NS-07 does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the 4 required, and 3/142 = 0.021, below 0.08), so no escalation follows from it.
The fee line is arithmetically sound — the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee — so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

The 'Entrance 1' reference in the rider's filed narrative against 'Entrance 3' in the contemporaneous chat message and trip record is immaterial: limb (c) is a distance test, and the rider's device stayed within 40 m of the pin throughout.
No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: both counterparty dispute counters are 0, rider no-show disputes in 30 days is 0, the sole-evidence limb is not engaged, and confidence is well above the 0.70 floor.
The refund moves only the contested cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.00; the SGD 0.50 platform fee is not contested and is not touched.

judged.text: Confidence is capped at 1.0 — the deciding facts rest on the trip record, GPS trace and chat log, each at weight_multiplier 1.0 — and I set it at 0.92.
Both parties: the rider wins, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full.
POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only where its four limbs hold AND no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them.

The Driver Advocate is right that the four limbs hold on this record, and I accept that: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50; the 100%-coverage GPS trace places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from that timestamp, closest approach 94.94 m; he held position for a single continuous in-geofence run of 340 seconds (12:41:50 to 12:47:30), 40 seconds beyond the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum; and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:47:30 under RIDER_UNREACHABLE with no boarding event.

I also accept the Driver Advocate's supporting points that POL-NS-05 is not engaged (the driver was stationary at 0.0 km/h inside the radius when the marker was set, so the marker is not false), that POL-NS-06 is not engaged (340 seconds against a 300-second minimum is a surplus, not a shortfall, so the rider gains nothing from that route), that POL-NS-03 is not engaged (the driver was inside the 120 m radius, not in the 120-to-400 m band, so there is no wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity case), and that POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged (the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee of SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X tier fee of SGD 4.00 is SGD 4.00, which is exactly the fare_breakdown cancellation line).
But all of that is displaced by POL-NS-04, and its three limbs hold.
(a) The chat log shows the rider sent locating/coordinating messages: 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' at 12:41:05, and 'boss?
i still cannot see u leh' at 12:44:40, the latter squarely inside the 12:41:50-12:47:30 waiting window and a statement that she could not see the vehicle.
(b) The driver answered neither message, within 120 seconds or at any point, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so he made neither a reply nor a voice call before terminating.

(c) The rider's device sat within a maximum of 39.93 m of the pin (mean 21.08 m, all 105 fixes qualifying, speed 0.0 km/h) against the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius — inside for every qualifying fix, not merely the majority.
Where all three limbs hold, POL-NS-04 refunds the cancellation fee in full with no driver compensation payable.
The claim that POL-NS-07 fixes compensation at 80% of SGD 4.00, i.e.

SGD 3.20, is rejected: POL-NS-07 compensation is payable only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 displaces it, so no compensation is owed.

The claim that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip is accepted (no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the required 4, so the first limb fails and the guard is not engaged) — but it is moot, because the guard is the only route to withholding compensation and compensation is not payable for the separate reason just given.
On the Driver Advocate's credibility point: the rider's filed narrative says 'Entrance 1' while the contemporaneous chat message and trip_record.pickup both say Entrance 3.
POL-NS-04 limb (c) is a distance test, the rider's position is fixed by GPS rather than by her narrative, and the message the driver actually saw and read named Entrance 3, matching the trip record.

judged.evidence: POLICY-NO-SHOW POL-NS-07 (packet directs full refund of the rider's cancellation fee)
judged.text: Under POL-NS-07 the packet directs the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full if the pattern is confirmed.

Confidence is 0.95; every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-TRIP-00207, EV-GPS-00207, EV-FARE-00207, EV-DPROF-00207) carries weight_multiplier 1.0, and the only sub-1.0 artifact, EV-ADVIS-00207-01 at weight 0.0 (MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no fact in this ruling and does not cap confidence.
To the rider: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee will not be collected from you or refunded to you by this process — it is held while a human reviewer decides.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs: EV-TRIP-00207 records the driver's 'arrived' event at 06:41:20 (limb a); EV-GPS-00207 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival geofence from 06:41:10, ten seconds before that marker, with 52 qualifying fixes and 100% coverage (limb b); he then held position continuously for 507 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (limb c); and the trip was terminated by the driver at 06:49:37 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW after that dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event (limb d).

Your statement that you 'came down a few minutes later' is not corroborated — your own device track sits about 1.9 km from the pin throughout the waiting window (min 1,894 m), you returned zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, and you sent no message in EV-CHAT-00207.

judged.evidence: EV-CHAT-00207, EV-TRIP-00207.payload.in_app_calls, EV-GPS-00207.payload.derived (dwell 507 s > 300 s), EV-ADVIS-00207-01
judged.text: POL-NS-04 therefore does not apply (limb (a) fails — no rider message — and limb (b) fails independently, the driver messaged from 06:42:30 and placed an unanswered in-app call at 06:45:10); POL-NS-03 does not apply (the stationary fixes are inside the 50 m radius, not the 50–400 m band); POL-NS-05 does not apply (closest approach 14.5 m, driver stationary at the marker, so no false-arrival trigger); and POL-NS-06 opens no shortfall route (507 s exceeds 300 s; the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 at weight 0.0 is not needed because no dwell accumulation across intervals is required).

The fare breakdown also reconciles cleanly: the greater of the SGD 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, matching the cancellation_fee line with a 0.00 difference, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.
Left there, the charge would stand and the driver would be due SGD 3.20 (80% of SGD 4.00) under POL-NS-07.
What changes the outcome is the driver's own trailing-30-day record, and it is decisive against the automated payout.

Under POL-NS-07 the anti-farming check trips: EV-DPROF-00207 shows 7 no-show terminations in 30 days against 61 completed trips — 11.5%, meeting both the 4-or-more count limb and the greater-than-0.08 rate limb.

POL-NS-07 therefore withholds the SGD 3.20 compensation and sends the case to human review under POL-NS-09(d), and it directs that the escalation packet instruct the reviewer to refund your fee in full.

judged.evidence: POL-GEN-03 (ESCALATE terminal, no monetary outcome); EV-FARE-00207.payload (payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00)
judged.text: Escalation is terminal: no money moves automatically, both money fields are empty, and the SGD 4.00 remains held rather than collected or refunded (EV-FARE-00207 already records payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

To the driver: your account of the trip is accepted on its merits — the arrival, the geofence, the 507-second hold and the RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code all check out, the rider's telemetry contradicts his own claim to have come down, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the charge.

Your own advocate correctly disclosed that the anti-farming limb of POL-NS-07 trips on your 30-day numbers, and neither the count (7) nor the rate (0.115) is mitigated by any other profile field — rating, acceptance_rate, active_region, prior_no_show_flags and the rest are context only under POL-GEN-01 and ground nothing here.
The consequence is that the platform will not pay the SGD 3.20 while that pattern stands, and the reviewer is directed to refund the rider's SGD 4.00.

The open question for the reviewer is whether the 11.5% trailing-30-day no-show termination rate reflects genuine rider no-shows or fee-harvesting; the disputed SGD 4.00 stays on hold until that is settled.

Confidence is 0.90: every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-TRIP-00207, EV-GPS-00207, EV-FARE-00207 and EV-DPROF-00207 — carries weight 1.0, and the only below-1.0 artifact, the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 at weight 0.0, carries no fact this ruling rests on.

judged.text: To both parties: the driver's arrival is not in question — the GPS trace places his device inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius for 25 consecutive fixes, which satisfies POL-NS-02 — but the fee turns on the dwell, and the dwell falls short.
POL-NS-01(c) measures the required 300-second hold from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 07:38:05 'arrived' tap.
The trace puts that first fix at 07:44:14 and the cancellation at 07:48:10: a single continuous hold of 236 seconds, 64 seconds short of the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum.
Limb (c) therefore fails, the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-06 refunds it in full with no driver compensation payable.

The recorded wait_time_min of 10.1 is real but is measured from the marker, which the policy does not accept — the derived offset shows the first in-geofence fix 369 seconds after the marker — and the driver was right not to rest the fee on it.

The SGD 6.00 has already been returned to the rider.

judged.text: Because this dispute was filed by the driver and his claim to restore the fee fails on that arithmetic, POL-GEN-03 gives NO_ACTION: the filing party's claim is not supported and the present state stands — the rider keeps the refund, no sum moves, and both money fields are null.
This is the driver-filed case POL-GEN-03 describes, where NO_ACTION leaves the rider refunded and never restores the charge.

judged.text: The dispute is the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider at Changi T1.

The fee itself is in order: EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee_schedule resolution rule (the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and payment_status is PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00.
The SGD 6.00 is held: not collected from the rider and not refunded.
The fee requires all four limbs of POL-NS-01.
Two are satisfied on the trip record: there is a driver 'arrived' event at 23:42:10, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises.

EV-GPS-00210 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) and (b): its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (the limit is 90), and it loses a 186-second sampling gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 that sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry.
Its weight is 0.25 and its issue codes are CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

Read at face value the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 404 seconds, 76 seconds short of the 480-second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-01(c) requires.
Corrected for the 228-second skew the same fix falls at 23:38:33 server time and the dwell is 632 seconds, comfortably over.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-00210 (CLOCK_SKEW detail 'No fix can be safely matched to the arrived event'; notes)
judged.text: The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between them, so limb (c) is undecided and limb (b) cannot be verified either, because no fix can be safely matched to the 23:42:10 arrival event.

The trip record EV-TRIP-00210 is also impaired, at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: its arrived_at of 23:42:10 and its implied 6.9-minute (415-second) wait cannot be reconciled with the trace.

On the parties' competing claims: the rider's case that the 6.9-minute window (415 seconds, from the arrival tap to cancellation) falls 65 seconds short reads the tap, but POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and once the skew is allowed for the same trace yields 632 seconds, so the shortfall is not proved.
The driver's case that the corrected 632 seconds puts him over the minimum is equally unprovable, because the 186-second gap hides the entry moment.
The accumulated-dwell route under POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable: EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, and the limb requires a present, populated advisory.

On POL-NS-02 the driver's closest approach of 96 m is inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius with 5 qualifying fixes, so proximity is met on the face of the trace, but that only turns the dispute to dwell, which is undecided.
The driver's compensation claim under POL-NS-07 (SGD 4.80, being 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee) fails because POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, which it is not.
The anti-farming check does not trip - no_show_terminations_30d of 2 is below 4 and 2/156 = 0.013 is below 0.08 - so no abuse finding and no packet from that branch.
On the rider's exoneration routes: POL-NS-04 does not apply, because the only surviving rider message ('why cancel??

i was at door 6') was sent at 23:49:40, after the 23:49:05 cancellation, so limb (a) fails, and limb (c) is undecidable because the trace carries no rider_track (PARTIAL_RECORD), which is neutral rather than adverse.
POL-NS-05 cannot be run at all while the 228-second skew makes the arrival marker unmatchable, so no false-arrival finding is entered.
POL-NS-03 is not engaged, the driver's fixes sitting inside the 150 m radius.
Confidence is capped at 0.25, the weight of the sole artifact (the GPS trace) that carries the dwell under POL-NS-01(c), far below the 0.70 floor.

Escalation is triggered three ways: POL-NS-09(b) (two admitted artifacts contradict on arrival and dwell, unresolved by any clause), POL-NS-09(e) (the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b)), and POL-NS-09(a) (confidence below the floor).
No referral is issued: POL-NS-05(ii) cannot fire because the clause cannot be run, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch has not tripped.

The open question for the reviewer is when the driver actually entered the geofence - whether the 228-second device skew should be corrected (632 seconds, fee chargeable) or not (404 seconds, fee refundable) - and whether the 186-second gap conceals an entry before 23:42:10.

The SGD 6.00 fee is placed on hold: it is not collected from the rider and not refunded, and no compensation is paid to the driver, until a human reviewer settles the single fact that decides the case — when the driver's car actually entered the Door 6 geofence at Changi T1.

I record that this is not an abuse finding against either party: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2/156 = 0.013, below the 0.08 rate limb), rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, and both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged.

The fee itself is correctly raised: EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and its SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line equals the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.
payment_status is PENDING and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so nothing has moved yet.

What is NOT settled is POL-NS-01 limb (c): a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 480 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap.

To the rider and the driver: the SGD 6.00 no-show fee is placed on HOLD.

Limbs (a) and (d) are met: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises.
The fee turns on limb (c): a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 480 seconds for an AIRPORT pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap.

The only artifact that measures that dwell is the GPS trace EV-GPS-00210, and it is broken four ways at once: its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (over the 90-second limb in POL-NS-08(a)), a 186-second sampling gap sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry, coverage is 22.8%, and the trace stops 149 seconds before the cancellation.

Both parties: the SGD 6.00 no-show charge for the Changi T1 pickup is placed on hold.

The open question for the reviewer is whether the driver in fact entered and held the Jurong East pickup geofence for the required 300 seconds on 2026-08-11.
